## NIKKE: Goddess of Victory — All banners [...] Gold Mileage is the pity system for the featured SSR. Each pull on the Special Recruit gives 1 Gold Mileage Ticket. At 200 tickets you can redeem the featured SSR in the shop. It does not carry over between banners.

### What does SSR mean in NIKKE?

SSR (Super Super Rare) is the highest rarity in NIKKE: Goddess of Victory, equivalent to 5★ in other gacha games. The base SSR rate is 4% per pull, increasing from pull 60 onward (soft pity).

### How does the 50/50 system work in NIKKE? [...] When you obtain an SSR on the Special Recruit, there is a 50% chance it is the featured SSR. If not, you accumulate Gold Mileage tickets toward the 200 needed for the guaranteed exchange.

### How many Gems do I need to guarantee the featured SSR?

In the worst case (200 Gold Mileage tickets without getting the featured SSR through 50/50) you need 200 pulls × 300 Gems = 60,000 Gems. On average with the 50/50 system, around 100–120 pulls (~30,000–36,000 Gems).

## Standard pool vs Pilgrim SSRs: how they change your odds [...] Step 1: Set up the formula. For a flat probability p per attempt, capped at n attempts, the expected number of pulls before you hit the featured SSR (or exhaust the guarantee) is:

E[pulls] = (1 − (1 − p)ⁿ) / p

Step 2: Plug in NIKKE’s real numbers. p = 0.02 (the featured SSR rate), n = 200 (the Gold Mileage cap).

(1 − 0.02)²⁰⁰ = 0.98²⁰⁰ ≈ 0.0176

E[pulls] = (1 − 0.0176) / 0.02 = 0.9824 / 0.02 ≈ 49.1 pulls

Step 3: Convert to Gems. 49.1 pulls × 300 Gems = 14,730 Gems on average. [...] ## Frequently asked questions

### What’s the SSR rate in NIKKE?

4% per pull on Special Recruit banners, with 2% of that going to the featured rate-up SSR and 2% spread across the rest of the SSR pool.

### Does NIKKE have a pity system?

Not in the traditional soft-pity sense confirmed elsewhere. NIKKE’s confirmed guarantee mechanic is Gold Mileage: one ticket per pull, redeemable for any featured SSR once you reach 200.
